reasoning: On the season so far the 76ers are the stronger team; with home court the 76ers start about 1 points better, in a game of about 224 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the 76ers win 54 times in 100, by about 1; most games like this end between 198 and 246 total points.
